author: S0LIX
body: Hey I am so sorry for hacking my brother showed me these hacks I had no idea what I was doing. I am so sorry and I love your server. Instead of a perma-ban make it temp-ban pls. I promise I am never hacking again and I dont want to lose one of my fav servers.

title: S0LIX Ban

replies.author: Junr
replies.body:
I'm sorry, but using hack clients are illegal on the Avicus Network. You may appeal again in 5-7 months and your chances of being unbanned are greater. 

This will remain open in the next 24 hours if you have any additional comments.
